Upadacitinib in RA is the analogue: its Phase 2 BALANCE-I and BALANCE-II completed in 2015-07 (NCT01960855, NCT02066389), its first Phase 3 started 2015-12-01 (SELECT-COMPARE, NCT02629159), and it was approved on 2019-08-16 (NDA 211675, openFDA drugsfda), so 2020 was its first full year. The same intervals from 2027-11 give a Phase 3 start in 2028-04, approval around 2031-12 and a first full year of 2032. One year is added because upadacitinib was a fast programme and this Phase 2 still has to choose one of three doses

Positive high-level results from the CLARITY-Gastric01 global Phase III trial showed that sonesitatug vedotin (Sone-Ve) demonstrated a statistically significant and highly clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival (OS) in 2nd and later-line Claudin 18.2-positive advanced gastric cancers versus investigator's choice of therapy.
